readerCopy.headline: Someone else's opportunity may change your plans too.
readerCopy.body:
A collaborator gets a bigger opportunity and suddenly needs more from you. Someone introduces you to a new circle. A client wants a larger commitment. A new person can enter your life with more presence than you expected and quickly change how much time the relationship takes. The opportunity may be theirs first and still alter your week.

Jupiter opposing your Ascendant puts growth across the table from you. Another person's expansion can benefit you, challenge you, or do both at once. Let the relationship grow at the speed the actual connection earns. You can support someone else's bigger chapter without giving it every open hour by default.
doNotAssume: Do not assume romance, partnership status, conflict, or that the other person's growth is good or bad.
